_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Muthu wa nthala vs Muthiki

📖 KUVANGULA KWAKU:
• Othala na {start_chips} mali
• Kikundi kimoja cha 52 karti (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Othala na muthiki (nyumba)
• Kila nthala ikulondeka muundo wa Ultimate Texas Hold'em: othala ANTE na BLIND bets, okala 2 karti za hole, okala PLAY bets za kusogea, okala karti za komuna, na okala maboko 5 abwana na muthiki. Othala na lengo la kuongeza mali yako (wakati o na maboko abwana), na kupunguza hasara yako (wakati o na maboko mabi).
• Muthala ukomeka wakati othala fika 0 mali au chini pa nthala ya kuanza (HASARA) au ukamilisha 1000 nthala na mali (USHINDI)

💰 KUWEKA BETS:
• ANTE: Kuweka ${ante} bet kila nthala
• BLIND: Kuweka ${ante} bet kila nthala
• PLAY: Kuweka bet wakati wa muthala. Kote nthala, othala chagua MOJA tu ya yafuatayo: (${ante4} wakati wa PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} wakati wa FLOP, au ${ante} wakati wa RIVER. Othala pia chagua kuacha muthala, na kupoteza bet.)

🎴 KUWEKA KARTI:
• Othala okala 2 karti za uso (kart za hole)
• Muthiki okala 2 karti za uso chini (kufichwa)
• Karti 5 za komuna zikala uso chini mwanzoni
• Karti za komuna zikala uso juu kote muthala

🏆 KUHALALISHA MUTHIKI:
• Muthiki lazima awe na angalau PAIR (2 karti za uso sawa) ili kuhakikisha, kwa kutumia karti 2 za uso na karti 5 za komuna.
• Kuhakikisha muthiki kuna athari kwa matokeo ya bets, kama itaelezwa baadaye.

🎮 MUTHALA NA MATENDO:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Matendo: [4x] (${ante4}) au [check]
  • [4x]: Weka ${ante4} PLAY bet, okala karti 3 za kwanza za komuna
  • [check]: Hakuna bet ya ziada, okala karti 3 za kwanza za komuna

📋 FLOP:
  • Ikiwa 4x bet iliwekwa: Chaguo pekee ni [skip] (auto-okala karti 2 za mwisho za komuna)
  • Ikiwa hakuna 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) au [check]
  • [2x]: Weka ${ante2} PLAY bet, okala karti 2 za mwisho za komuna
  • [check]: Hakuna bet ya ziada, okala karti 2 za mwisho za komuna

📋 RIVER:
  • Ikiwa 4x au 2x bet iliwekwa: Chaguo pekee ni [skip] (auto-endelea na muthala)
  • Ikiwa hakuna PLAY bet ya awali: [1x] (${ante}) au [fold]
  • [1x]: Weka ${ante} PLAY bet, endelea na muthala
  • [fold]: Acha muthala, poteza ANTE na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Karti zote zikala na kuthaminiwa
  • Maboko 5 abwana kutoka kwa karti 7 (2 za hole + 5 za komuna)
  • Bets zitatuliwa kulingana na kanuni za malipo

💎 MALIPO YA BETS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Muthiki hakuhakikisha: PUSH (bet ilirejeshwa)
  • Muthiki akahakikisha na othala ushinde: 1:1 malipo (bet + ushindi)
  • Muthiki akahakikisha na othala upoteze: Bet ilipotea
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ilirejeshwa)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Haiathiriwi na kuhakikisha muthiki
  • Othala ushinde: Bet ilirejeshwa na malipo ya ziada kulingana na nguvu ya maboko
  • Othala upoteze: Bet ilipotea
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ilirejeshwa)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Chini ya Straight: Hakuna malipo ya ziada

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Haiathiriwi na kuhakikisha muthiki
  • Ulinganisho wa moja kwa moja: Maboko yako abwana vs Maboko ya muthiki
  • Othala ushinde: 1:1 malipo (bet + ushindi)
  • Othala upoteze: Bet ilipotea
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ilirejeshwa)

🎯 NGUVU ZA MABOKO (Bora hadi Mbaya):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ya uso sawa
  2. Straight Flush: Karti 5 mfululizo za uso sawa
  3. Four of a Kind: Karti 4 za uso sawa
  4. Full House: 3 za aina + 2 za aina
  5. Flush: Karti 5 za uso sawa
  6. Straight: Karti 5 mfululizo
  7. Three of a Kind: Karti 3 za uso sawa
  8. Two Pair: Jozi 2 za aina tofauti
  9. One Pair: Karti 2 za uso sawa
  10. High Card: Karti ya juu inashinda

⌨️  AMRI ZA MATENDO:
• [4x] au [play bet 4x]: Weka ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] au [play bet 2x]: Weka ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] au [play bet 1x]: Weka ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] au [c]: Hakuna bet ya ziada
• [fold] au [f]: Acha muthala
• [skip] au [s]: Endelea na muthala unaofuata (wakati hakuna kitendo kinachohitajika)

💡 MAONI YA MKAKATI:
• Mikono ya kuanza yenye nguvu (jozi, karti za juu) mara nyingi huhalalisha bets za 4x
• Zingatia kuhakikisha muthiki - mikono dhaifu inaweza kusukuma ikiwa muthiki hakuhakikisha
• Bet ya BLIND inaweza kuwa faida kubwa na mikono yenye nguvu (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Angalia mali yako! Ikiwa itashuka hadi 0 au chini ya mwanzo wa muthala, othala upoteze.

⚠️  MAONI MUHIMU:
• Bets za ANTE na BLIND ni lazima kila muthala
• Bets za PLAY ni za hiari na za mkakati
• Hakikisha kuweka kitendo sahihi, na kitendo kimoja tu kwa wakati mmoja.
